author: Nashville Standard
title: Lipscomb men's golf in third after two rounds at ASUN Championship - Nashville Standard
text:
Lipscomb Men’s Golf is in third place after two rounds at the ASUN Championship with an overall score of 571, five strokes under par, according to an April 22 update from the team.
The tournament’s progress matters as teams vie for conference titles and individual honors. The Bisons improved their first round score by one stroke on Wednesday, finishing with a 285, three under par.
Alexander Moeldrup led Lipscomb in the second round by shooting five under par. He began his round with four birdies on the front nine and continued his momentum with consecutive birdies on holes ten and eleven. Moeldrup finished his day at 67, tying for the second-best round in the field. After going even par in Tuesday’s opening round, he is now tied for fifth place overall at five under par.
Minas Manias sits just behind Moeldrup at three under par and tied for twelfth place. After having Lipscomb’s best first-round performance Tuesday, Manias shot a one-over-par 73 on Wednesday. Despite a rough start over the first nine holes, he recovered with four birdies and four pars on the back nine to remain near the top of the leaderboard.
Toby Bishop is tied for twenty-second after improving by two strokes in his second round to finish even par for that day. His performance included early bogeys but was balanced out by birdies before making the turn; he maintained even par through consistent play over both nines.
Rio Saigal provided Lipscomb’s final counting score of Wednesday’s round with a one-over-par 73. Saigal overcame early bogeys to record steady pars and a late birdie, finishing strong over his last few holes; he is currently tied for thirty-third overall at five over par.
Ciaran Murphy is tied for twenty-ninth after carding a four-over-par seventy-six on Wednesday following an even-par seventy-two Tuesday. Although Murphy managed two birdies during his second round, additional bogeys kept him slightly above par.
The Bisons will begin Thursday’s final championship round teeing off from hole one starting at 7:00 a.m., concluding their staggered starts with Minas Manias teeing off last among them.
